shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用叠放扇形同时讲清一件版型与多件装价值。
让买家把自己代入慵懒日常，确认版型贴身但不紧绷。
一秒给出核心主张，用三条引线把领口、袖身、下摆的卖点分层讲清。
shots.textZone: right-hand column: one headline slot plus three stacked callout slots aligned to hairline rules

shots.intent: 让买家在并排色位之间做出选择，同时坐实多件装的份量感。
用三段结构特写自证做工与面料表面状态，替买家回答耐穿吗。
把基础衫放进通勤与外出场景，证明活动量下依然贴身不外翻。
收口促成下单，用一格主片加三格小片的造型矩阵给出买一件穿三季的理由。
shots.textZone: centre gutter band between the large panel and the three insets: one short headline slot

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio paper white #FFFFFF for the packshot, benefit and commute screens, flat cool mist-blue paper #E7EBF0 for the overhead colorway row and the styling grid, deep ink #1B222B panel fields only inside the three-band detail macro screen; flat low-contrast surfaces, no gradient, no storefront lettering
style.direction: clean premium womens basics apparel commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks only, one accent #BE8A8F used solely as a short underline bar beneath a callout
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced cool studio light around 5600K, large front-left softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft low-contrast shadows that always keep a contact shadow grounding the garment; low skimming sweep light only inside the macro band to read the knit face
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womens-basics apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, cool mist-blue #E7EBF0, deep ink #1B222B and one accent #BE8A8F; cool daylight-balanced studio lighting around 5600K with a large front-left softbox key, bounce fill and soft low-contrast contact shadows that always ground the garment; matte seamless paper cyclorama and flat mist-blue paper surfaces only; modern geometric sans-serif with hairline leader rules and never dense body copy; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; garment always shown with readable neckline, both sleeve lengths and side seam, worn by a generic faceless body cropped above the collarbone; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no identifiable model face or celebrity likeness
no invented fabric weights, percentages, measurements or test figures
style.presentationRules: the garment always shows the neckline, both sleeve lengths and the side seam silhouette; on-body screens crop the body above the collarbone so no face is ever carried; scale and centering of the worn piece stay stable across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama for on-body screens, matte mist-blue paper counter for the overhead flat row, smooth pale plaster-like plane for the single hard-shadow styling panel
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, headline plus at most three short callouts, hairline leader rules, never dense body copy
